anchoredLines.line: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Kavya. Sunback, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Felix Silva. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
The fire is quieter on hungry mornings. Nobody has spare breath for talking.
